changelog.change: The first plan: conversations.conversation_archived and conversations.conversation_unarchived, with a conversations.conversation snapshot (the reference flow of ADR 0020).

The conversations module instrumented (campbooks-cloud#325): 40 events for flags, streams, labels, needs, drafts and sends, taught rules and their runs, suggestions, person notes, provider batches, the model pass, Scout's reads and inboxes; records draft, need, rule and rule_run; Coverage for every operation, job, schedule and handler of the module.

description: The tracking plan (ADR 0020), generated from tracking/tracking-plan.xlsx by campbooks-tracking-plan. Do not edit: change the workbook and regenerate. Every event's `schema` is the JSON Schema of its body; `envelope` is the schema of what the kernel adds around it.

enums.description: A member said it is done.
The person waited on wrote back.
A member said it is not needed.
No message is in the inbox, and it is not binned.
At least one message is in the inbox.
Every message is in the trash or spam, at least one in the trash.
A nudge to someone the member waits on.

Sent, waiting out its undo window.

Does it ask for an action?

The wait passed its nudge time.
Someone is waiting for an answer.
Look before acting: a warning, or a question to the member.
Someone else has the next move.
A taught rule keeps it in front of the member until opened.
A suggestion put to the member as a question.

Never for this sender and kind.

Its domain is too broad to trust.
Take it out of the inbox.
Whether it asks for an action.
Keep it in front of the member until opened.
From what the member told Scout.
Applying it to the mail already there.

A reason this plan does not know yet.
